title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 97-100 (Vishnu Vakshasthala Sthita, Vishnupatni, Prasannakshi, Narayanasamashrita)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 97 to 100: Vishnu Vakshasthala Sthita, Vishnupatni, Prasannakshi, Narayanasamashrita, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 97 to 100 with meaning
caption: Names 97 to 100 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 97 to 100**: **Vishnu Vakshasthala Sthita, Vishnupatni, Prasannakshi, Narayanasamashrita**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Vishnu Vakshasthala Sthita, Vishnupatni, Prasannakshi, Narayanasamashrita.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

sections.h: Vishnu Vakshasthala Sthita: Seated on Vishnu's chest
p: **Vishnu Vakshasthala Sthita** means **Seated on Vishnu's chest**. The gods saw her on Hari's chest and felt relief at once. Vishnu bears the Srivatsa mark for her.
**Vishnupatni** means **Consort of Vishnu**. Consort of Vishnu; in each avatar she takes a matching form.
**Narayanasamashrita** means **United with Narayana**. She takes refuge in Narayana and never leaves him; devotees pray to both together.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
